text:
Priya: Hi team 1I have a few onboarding questions: 1) When will I get my first paycheck? 2) I'm on US payroll but based in SpainI uploaded a Spanish tax form and a W-4 1 which one should I keep? 3) I moved last week - where do I upload moving / temporary housing receipts for relocation reimbursement?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Priya! :wave: Payroll dates are the 1st and 15th. New hires usually hit the next run after payroll receives completed forms and bank details. If you started 4/2, expect the 4/15 run.

Luis - Payroll: Quick clarifier: cutoff is 5 business days before the pay run. If your banking + tax docs were in before that cutoff you'll be on the same run. If not, next run. For internationals: if your employment is recorded as US payroll we require the W-4 for federal withholding; we can accept local forms for state/local where applicable but W-4 governs federal. DM me your country and contract if you want us to double-check.

Priya: I'm definitely on US payroll (signed US offer). I set my address to Spain in the portal. Is that okay? Any tax withholding impact?

Maya (People Ops): That's fine. Payroll will apply US federal withholding per the W-4 and adapt state/local if relevant. You may have additional local tax obligations in Spain; please consult a tax advisor for local filings. We do provide a list of recommended tax contacts in Madrid - ping people-ops if you'd like it.

Priya: Great, thanks. About relocation receipts - where exactly to upload and what metadata do you need?

Nora: Upload to HR Portal > Expenses > Relocation (choose "Relocation - New Hire"). Please include: original receipt PDF, short note (what it was for), and the job code. File name example we prefer: RELO_PRIYA_2026_airbnb.pdf. If multiple receipts, zip them and include a single manifest.txt listing files and amounts.

Luis - Payroll: Add code RELO-APR-2026 in the "Notes" field so Accounting tags it correctly. Reimbursements process on the monthly expense cycle (usually first Friday after validation). Allow 7-10 business days after approval for payment.

Priya: Is there a deadline to submit relocation receipts?

Maya (People Ops): Please submit within 60 days of your start date for typical relocation packages. If you need an exception, DM us with dates and amounts.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Benefits enrollment window = 30 days from start. Docs for dependents required if enrolling them. HR portal link: https://hr.redwood.example/enroll

Priya: Awesome, I'll upload W-4 + receipts today and DM Luis the country details. Thanks all :smile:
